prompt: 3D animated film style, same characters and look as the frames. Ana, a young curly-haired manicurist, sits at her manicure table with her hands together; the smartphone lying flat on the table glows with intense violet light. Suddenly the phone screen becomes a magical portal: a swirling vortex of violet and magenta light spirals out of it and sucks Ana in. She is lifted from her chair and pulled head-first into the glowing screen, hair and apron fluttering, surprised and excited; her beagle puppy holds on to the table, ears blown towards the phone, then jumps in after her. The camera follows her through the screen into a magical violet digital world with a glowing grid floor, floating particles and four blank glowing frosted cards, where Ana and the beagle float weightless, amazed. Smooth, fun, magical motion. No text, no letters.
